newsitem.title: USA: Holder urges WHG Bancshares to raise value.
newsitem.headline: Holder urges WHG Bancshares to raise value.

text.p: Investor Jerome Davis said Friday he has proposed several steps by which WHG Bancshares Corp may improve shareholder value.
Davis, who along with his wife hold a 9.94 percent stake in WHG, said those steps include a share repurchase to the maximum extent allowable at up to $14.375 a share or 100 percent of book value.
In addition, he said the WHG may increase its dividend by $0.01 a quarter for the next three quarters and pay a special dividend of up to $7.00 a share, even on a taxable basis.
Davis said his suggestions, if implemented, would improve WHG's return on earnings, provide shareholders with substantial cash for reinvestment and lower WHG's price/earnings ratio.
His suggestions, he said, will also make WHG more attrative to a potential acquiror.
